summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 to report an unregistered sale of 1,934,637 Class I common shares at NAV of $26.95 per share, raising $52.1 million. The sale relied on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S exemptions. The filing also disclosed April 30, 2026 NAV, aggregate NAV of $10.7B, portfolio fair value of $21.3B, debt of $10.9B (1.05x leverage), and regular monthly distributions. This is a routine capital raise and NAV/disclosure update, not a special situation. No event triggers a special-situations category.
